column5: After finding a stationary minimizer z, what four links give convergence?
column6:
Set \(\Delta_n=f(x_n)-f(z)\).

  1. Strong convexity: \(\tfrac m2\lVert x_n-z\rVert^2\le\Delta_n\).
  2. One-step descent plus the gradient gap bound: \(\Delta_{n+1}\le\rho\Delta_n\).
  3. Induction: \(\Delta_n\le\rho^n\Delta_0\).
  4. For \(0\le\rho<1\), geometric decay and the lower bound force \(x_n\to z\).
